description: An unobtrusive and user-friendly desktop application for IPFS on Windows, Mac and Linux.
readme_summary: **IPFS Desktop gives you all the power of IPFS in a convenient desktop app: a complete IPFS node, plus handy OS menubar/taskbar shortcuts and an all-in-one file manager, peer map, and content explorer.** Use IPFS Desktop to get acquainted with IPFS without needing to touch the terminal — or, if you're already experienced, use the powerful menubar/taskbar shortcuts alongside the command line to make your IPFS workflow faster. When in doubt, pick one of package formats with built-in automatic update mechanism: - **Windows:** ipfs-desktop-setup-0.50.1-win-x64.exe - **Mac:** ipfs-desktop-0.50.1-mac.dmg - **Linux:** ipfs-desktop-0.50.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage - If you prefer to manage updates on your own, see other package formats below.
